info.title: Poof API
info.description: The developer-first standard for background removal. Precise, fast, and scalable.

post.description: Remove the background from an image or a video. The media type is detected from the file's bytes, never from the field name or extension. Images are processed synchronously: the response body is the processed image (200). Videos are processed asynchronously: the request is answered with 202 and a job object; poll GET /jobs/{id} until status is completed, then download result_url. Images cost 1 credit per successful request. Videos cost 5 credits per started second of source video (10 per second above 30 fps), charged on acceptance and refunded automatically if the job fails. Failed requests are not billed. Video limits: 5 minutes, 100 MB upload or 500 MB via url; output is capped at 1080p (longest side 1920 px) and audio is preserved.

file.description: The image or video file to process. Images: JPEG, PNG, WebP, GIF (first frame), BMP, TIFF, HEIC or AVIF, max 20 MB. Videos: MP4, MOV, WebM, M4V or MKV, max 100 MB (use url for files up to 500 MB). Required unless url or image_file_b64 is given. image_file is accepted as an alias.

url.description: Public http(s) URL of the image or video to process; Poof fetches it server-side (images max 20 MB, videos max 500 MB, up to 3 redirects, 15s timeout). URLs pointing at private, loopback or link-local addresses are rejected. Alternative to file. image_url is accepted as an alias.

image_file_b64.description: The image as a base64 string, with or without a data:<mime>;base64, prefix. Max 20 MB decoded. Images only: a base64-encoded video is rejected with 400 validation_error. Alternative to file.

image_file.description: Alias of file, kept for remove.bg compatibility.

image_url.description: Alias of url, kept for remove.bg compatibility.

format.description: Output format. Images: png (default), jpg or webp. Videos: webm (default; VP9 with alpha, Opus audio), mov (ProRes 4444 with alpha, AAC audio) or mp4 (H.264 without alpha: the subject is composited on bg_color, AAC audio). A format from the other media family is rejected with 400 validation_error listing the valid values. For remove.bg compatibility, auto is accepted and treated as png; zip is not supported.

channels.description: Output color channels. 'rgba': keep transparency (for video, webm and mov carry alpha; mp4 has none and is composited on bg_color). 'rgb': opaque output with the background filled with bg_color (white by default). 'alpha': the grayscale matte only (for video, a grayscale matte video without audio).

bg_color.description: Background color (hex, rgb() or color name) used whenever the output has no alpha: channels 'rgb', format 'jpg' or format 'mp4'. Defaults to white. Ignored when the output keeps transparency.

size.description: Output size preset. Images: megapixel cap, ignored when width or height is set. Videos: the same presets, with full capped at 1080p (longest side 1920 px). For remove.bg compatibility the aliases auto, 4k and 50MP (treated as full) and small and regular (treated as preview) are also accepted.

crop.description: Images only: a video request with this field is rejected with 400 validation_error naming the field. Crop the image to the subject bounds. Pass true/false or an aspect ratio like '1:1', '4:3', '16:9'.

padding.description: Images only: a video request with this field is rejected with 400 validation_error naming the field. Padding around the subject when crop is enabled, added to each side as a fraction (e.g. '0.1') or percentage (e.g. '10%') of the subject's size on that axis. Pass one value for both axes, or two comma-separated values as horizontal,vertical (e.g. '10%,7.5%' gives a canvas 120% of subject width and 115% of subject height). Default '10%'.

crop_margin.description: Images only: a video request with this field is rejected with 400 validation_error naming the field. remove.bg-compatible alias for padding, using CSS margin shorthand with one to four space-separated values (e.g. '10%' or '0px 5%'). Percentages map onto padding; a zero pixel margin means a tight crop; other pixel margins cannot be honoured and are ignored. Ignored when padding is set.

width.description: Images only: a video request with this field is rejected with 400 validation_error naming the field. Output width in pixels (1-6000). On its own, the height follows the image's aspect ratio. Together with height, the image is fitted into a width x height canvas according to fit. The aspect ratio is always preserved (never stretched); smaller images are upscaled unless fit is 'scale-down'. Overrides size.

height.description: Images only: a video request with this field is rejected with 400 validation_error naming the field. Output height in pixels (1-6000). On its own, the width follows the image's aspect ratio. Together with width, the image is fitted into a width x height canvas according to fit. The aspect ratio is always preserved (never stretched); smaller images are upscaled unless fit is 'scale-down'. Overrides size.

fit.description: Images only: a video request with this field is rejected with 400 validation_error naming the field. How to fit the image into width/height. 'contain' scales the image to fit inside and centres it, filling the remaining area with transparency (or bg_color). 'cover' scales the image to fill the canvas and crops the overflow, keeping the subject centred. 'scale-down' is like 'contain' but never enlarges: a smaller image keeps its native size (centred on the canvas when both dimensions are set). contain and cover only differ when both width and height are set.

schema.description: Provide exactly one input: file (upload), url (public URL) or image_file_b64 (base64, images only). If several are sent, file wins, then image_file_b64, then url. The remove.bg field names image_file and image_url are accepted as aliases of file and url.

200.description: Image processed successfully: the body is the output image

Content-Type.description: MIME type of the returned image

X-Matte-Confidence.description: Heuristic confidence in the alpha matte, 0-1. Mean decisiveness of the mask: 1 means fully binary, lower values mean the model hedged. Not a calibrated probability.

X-Matte-Ambiguous-Ratio.description: Fraction of pixels with alpha between 0.1 and 0.9, 0-1. High values indicate large uncertain regions; useful for flagging results for review.

202.description: Video accepted as a job. The video has been probed, credits have been charged and processing has been queued. Poll status_url.

get.description: Returns the current state of a job created by POST /remove for a video: status (queued, processing, completed or failed), progress from 0 to 1, and once completed the result_url, a direct download link on the Poof CDN that stays valid until expires_at (24 hours after completion). Polling is free and exempt from your plan's rate limit; poll every 2 to 5 seconds. A failed job carries an error object and its credits are refunded automatically. Unknown or expired jobs return 404 job_not_found.

ApiKeyAuth.description: Your API key. Get one at https://dash.poof.bg

Error.description: Error body returned by every non-2xx response. The X-Request-ID response header equals request_id.

details.description: Optional additional context. For validation_error this is an object mapping field names to a list of messages.

request_id.description: Unique request ID for support (also sent as the X-Request-ID header)

doc_url.description: Link to the documentation page for this error code

maxCredits.description: Total credits available in billing cycle

usedCredits.description: Credits used in current billing cycle

autoRechargeThreshold.description: Fraction of the plan limit at which Auto Recharge triggers (e.g. 0.9 = 90%). Omitted when Auto Recharge is off.

Job.description: A video background-removal job, as returned by POST /remove (202) and GET /jobs/{id}.

status.description: Job state. queued and processing are transient; completed and failed are terminal.

progress.description: Fraction of the video processed so far, 0 to 1

started_at.description: When processing began; null while queued

completed_at.description: When the job reached completed or failed; null until then

frames.description: Number of frames in the source video

credits.description: Credits charged for this job (5 per started second of source video; 10 per second above 30 fps). Refunded automatically if the job fails.

status_url.description: URL of the job; GET it to poll for progress

result_url.description: Direct download URL of the result on the Poof CDN (https://cdn.poof.bg/...), valid until expires_at; null until the job is completed

expires_at.description: When the result is deleted, 24 hours after completion; null until the job is completed

error.description: Set when status is failed, null otherwise

message.example: The model or encoder failed on this video.

stats.description: Processing statistics, null until the job has run. output_width and output_height are the output dimensions (the output is capped at 1920 px on the longest side; width and height above are the source dimensions) and processing_seconds the wall-clock processing time. Other keys are informational and may change.
